verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a native bulk-operations feature. Bulk handling of many items (connections, sources, configurations) has to be inferred from programmatic surfaces: the Terraform provider manages configuration as code, the Airbyte API supports programmatic control alongside orchestrators like Airflow, and PyAirbyte is available for scripting. These let users script changes across many items, but only through extra tooling. missing for 10: documented native bulk actions (e.g., bulk-edit, pause or sync many connections at once), API batch endpoints, agent/MCP-driven bulk operations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
